//: Standalone Hosting config for deploying dist/pyodide to a NEW project's DEFAULT site (Spark-plan friendly). Object form (no 'target'/'site' array) = the project's single default site, which is free on Spark. Do NOT run 'firebase hosting:sites:create' -- extra named sites require Blaze. Deploy with: firebase deploy --only hosting --config firebase.spark.json --project <YOUR_NEW_PROJECT_ID>
